column1: # One row per file a run loads:  profile <TAB> component <TAB> multiplier <TAB> path
# `multiplier` is how many times the run pays for that file. It is 1 for anything
# the orchestrator Reads once and the spawn count for an agent body, because a
# body is injected whole as each subagent's system prompt (.claude/rules/skill-
# structure.md §File-size limits) — the one term where static size and per-run
# The composition below is a JUDGEMENT about which files a run actually loads,
# recorded as data precisely so it can be argued with one line at a time. The
# script contributes only the arithmetic; it holds no numbers of its own.
# R1 — the floor. Six always-fire dimensions plus the broad-trigger `optimizations`
#      conditional, no spec, no PR, no deep mode, no verifiers, no custom
#      reviewers. No other conditional is triggered.
# R2 — the ceiling for built-in dimensions. All ten fire (six always-fire
#      dimensions plus the broad-trigger `optimizations` conditional, and design,
#      pr-metadata and spec-compliance), a spec and a PR are present, and the
#      survivor set draws five verifier spawns.
# On the spec's "11 dimensions" for R2: the built-in grid at
# skills/review/phase-2-spawns.md §2.1 holds ten rows, so eleven counts one
# custom reviewer. A custom reviewer's criteria file is user-authored and lives
# outside this repo, so its words cannot be measured here. R2 therefore pins the
# ten built-ins and says so, rather than inventing a row.
# Excluded from both profiles, deliberately: the adversarial-tester spawn (its
# Phase 4.3 gate is approval-bound, so it is not part of a floor or a ceiling),
# the deep-mode paths (both profiles are single-pass), memory-backend.md
# (loaded only when a project declares a backend), and spawn-agent.md /
# model-tiering.md — phase-2-spawns.md gates the spawn-agent.md Read behind a
# not-found error or an empty spawn result, and model-tiering.md is cited, not
# Read, at every review call site; neither is paid for on the happy path this
# ---- R1: per-dimension criteria (six always-fire dims plus the broad-trigger `optimizations` conditional; conventions owns three files) ----
# ---- R1: agent bodies (7 dimension spawns, no verifiers) ----
# ---- R2: orchestrator (R1's set plus what a spec, a PR and a verify pass add) ----
# ---- R2: per-dimension criteria (all ten built-in dims) ----
# ---- R2: agent bodies (10 dimension spawns + 5 verifier spawns) ----
